snippet.description:
사우디아라비아 수도 리야드가 후티 반군의 공습을 받아 최소한 12명이 숨지고 3백여 명이 다쳤습니다.

4. 사우디 기대감 산산조각…'내 코가 석자' 등 돌린 트럼프 [지금이뉴스] (261007)
5. 홍해 길목 되찾은 예멘 정부군...후티 "사우디 영공도 전쟁터" (261006 권준기 기자)
6. 후티의 급성장과 중국의 위험한 '양다리' (261003 권영희 기자)
7. "남북한 전쟁도 막고 있는데"...트럼프, 노벨평화상 수상 불발에 격앙 (261010 유투권 기자)
8. 12조 원 짜리 통째로 사들이더니…'호르무즈 제로' 초대형 승부수 [지금이뉴스] (260930)
9. 트럼프 "이란, LA·샌디에이고 파괴하게 둬라"...민주당, 강력 반발 (261007 홍상희 기자)
10. 잡히면 이란 드론 폭격…'필사의 작전' 펼치는 사우디·이라크 [지금이뉴스] (260928)

snippet.title: Smart carpentry workflow: Pre-aligned screw driving process for fast outdoor deck construction
snippet.description:
In outdoor deck building, timber framing, and heavy wooden patio construction, framing contractors frequently face time-consuming challenges when driving multiple structural fasteners into dense dimensional lumber. Manually placing individual screws without prior alignment leads to awkward posture, crooked screw entry, and slow assembly times across large framing layouts.

This efficient framing fastening technique utilizes a high-torque cordless impact driver combined with pre-arranged screws inserted directly into the wooden joist face. By positioning multiple screws along the timber edge beforehand and driving them sequentially using the power tool, the builder rapidly locks the wooden framework together in a continuous motion.

By utilizing pre-set screw placement and high-speed impact drivers, carpenters minimize tool handling fatigue, eliminate awkward fumbling, and drastically speed up structural framing production. Professional framers, deck builders, and heavy construction DIYers rely on rapid screw-driving workflows to complete durable timber structures efficiently.

snippet.title: 【速報】NARUTO完全新作アニメはまさかの『忍空』コラボ！全4話『NARUTO×NINKU』制作決定
snippet.description:
3年前に放送延期となっていた『NARUTO-ナルト-』の完全新作アニメが、まさかの『NINKU -忍空-』とのコラボで帰ってきます。
アメリカ時間の10月10日、ニューヨーク・コミコン2026で発表されました。
あなたは楽しみ？ ぜひコメントで教えてください。

▼この動画のポイント
1. タイトルは『NARUTO-ナルト-×NINKŪ-忍空-』。全4話で制作中
2. 少年時代のナルトたち第七班が忍空の世界に迷い込み、風助たちと出会うオリジナルストーリー。岸本斉史先生・桐山光侍先生が全話を監修
3. 岸本先生「『忍空』がなければ『NARUTO』は存在していません」。忍空の続きが見たくてNARUTOを描いた、その夢が実現
4. 監督・阿部記之さん、キャラクターデザイン・西尾鉄也さんは、アニメ『忍空』（1995年）と同じ顔ぶれ。アニメーション制作はstudioぴえろ
5. 風助役・松本梨香さん、里穂子役・林原めぐみさんら、忍空のオリジナルキャストが再集結
6. 主題歌はオープニング「GO!!!」、エンディング「ビバ★ロック」をFLOWが担当
7. Xでは「まさか」「懐かしすぎる」の声が続出。一方で「3年待ってコラボ？」と戸惑う声も
※放送日・配信先は2026年10月11日時点で未発表です

snippet.title: Quería dejarle una herencia a su hijo… y su madre le dijo esto 😳
snippet.description:
Un hombre llegó muy entusiasmado a contarle a su madre que quería construirle una casa a su hijo para que, cuando se casara, ya tuviera dónde vivir. 🏠❤️ Pero la abuela, que había levantado su propio hogar desde cero, no pudo quedarse callada. 😳

Para ella, ayudar a los hijos está bien, pero una cosa es echarles la mano y otra muy distinta es darles todo servido sin enseñarles a trabajar. Porque hay padres que se parten el espinazo construyendo un patrimonio que sus hijos después no saben valorar.

Como dice la abuela: “¡Pos cómo les va a doler perder lo que nunca les costó!” 👵🏼🔥

Y también dejó algo muy claro: los padres tienen derecho a descansar, disfrutar de su dinero y vivir tranquilos después de tantos años de sacrificio. No tienen que quedarse sin nada para dejarles una herencia a sus hijos.

¿Ustedes qué opinan? ¿Es mejor dejarles una casa a los hijos o enseñarles a conseguir la suya?

Si también creen que a los hijos hay que enseñarles a trabajar y valorar lo que tienen, escriban: QUE SE LO GANEN. 💪❤️

snippet.description:
The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has approached the Telangana High Court seeking to expedite the trial in the alleged disproportionate assets and money laundering cases involving YS Jagan Mohan Reddy. The move has sparked fresh political and legal debate in Andhra Pradesh. The ED has reportedly requested day-to-day hearings and sought directions for Jagan and other accused to appear personally before the Nampally CBI Court. According to the petition, nine ED charge sheets registered under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act have been pending for years, raising concerns over the prolonged delay in the legal proceedings. The cases relate to alleged quid pro quo investments during the tenure of former Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister YS Rajasekhara Reddy. Investigating agencies alleged that certain companies received government land, mining leases and industrial concessions, while investments were made in businesses associated with his son, YS Jagan Mohan Reddy. These included Jagathi Publications, which publishes Sakshi, Bharathi Cements and Sandur Power. The allegations centre on investments made at unusually high valuations and the alleged transfer of funds in return for government favours. The investigation covers several prominent cases, including Vanpic, Penna Cements, Dalmia Cements, India Cements, Lepakshi Knowledge Hub and housing board projects. The CBI and ED have filed multiple charge sheets in connection with these matters. However, the proceedings have faced prolonged delays, with discharge petitions and repeated adjournments contributing to the slow progress of the cases. The ED is now seeking faster judicial proceedings, arguing that economic offences involving alleged money laundering require timely investigation and trial. If the High Court orders day-to-day hearings, the development could have significant implications for the progress of these long-pending cases. The upcoming court proceedings and the expected decision on October 13 could become an important development in the case.
